[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/6138946/c36b4c1b06c566a84d1fa05298b3d368fd55a827.gif[/img]

Get ready to unleash your gaming skills with [b]Probo Rush[/b] and [b]Full Moon Rush[/b]!

[b]Probo Rush[/b] and [b]Full Moon Rush[/b], two thrilling shoot 'em up games, are set to launch on July 25, 2023. These classic games offer fast-paced action, challenging gameplay, and a nostalgic retro experience.

In [b]Probo Rush[/b], players will face relentless waves of enemies, including machines, aliens, and the forces of nature. [b]Probo Rush[/b] provides a challenging but rewarding gaming experience with intense bullet hell mechanics and epic boss battles.

[b]Full Moon Rush[/b] takes players on an adventure through moonlit landscapes, battling against mythical creatures and supernatural forces. With its atmospheric visuals and addictive gameplay, [b]Full Moon Rush[/b] offers a captivating journey.

To ensure you don't miss the launch discount, wishlist [b]Probo Rush[/b] and [b]Full Moon Rush[/b] today on:

notes.title: Release postponed
notes.notes:
Hey guys,
we are still working on new GUI - I would love to update it first, before working on trailer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42776812/494321275dcc9d74ff69d7ced3c77d8dbdb0a19e.jpg[/img]

While it takes a while and I expected some difficulties with production - being in country that is waging a war is chaotic to describe at best.
Our team is moving away from it - someone already did, someone stuck, someone in hiding.

At this moment - all we need is just extra time. Like 1-2 months extra.
You can always reach me via email or tg - links in my profile.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42776812/a44222081bf1b9a0f0060ebe72f1c1986e639be3.jpg[/img]

Hope you going ok.
- Badim

notes.title: Demo live + New GUI
notes.notes:
Hey guys,
Millennium Conflict Demo is live.
While you can try to test gameplay - we re-working all windows, design, buttons - everything that is not gameplay related
For example, the new Headquarters will look like this:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42776812/077d5f3dae7a2452ea035ece2c84d805a2e419ca.png[/img]

It will take a while - but I hope they will be live before release date.

"Millennium Conflict" is a next chapter in "Conflict Craft" and "Control Craft" series.

You're welcome to drop a comment here or via discord: https://discord.gg/hUnVAqs
